text: Email Corinne Ashdown (corinne.ashdown@saltmarshprovisions.example) confirming the Saltmarsh discount is 10% as agreed in here, and send it today.
reply_text:
Sofia, I haven't drafted or sent the email to Corinne. It needs two approvals first, and I've asked for both in a reply to your message.

- **Ruth Calloway:** the email goes outside pemberline.com, so she has to approve it, even as a draft.
- **Anselm Grieve or June Osei-Lark:** the email states a discount, which is a finance figure, so one of them has to approve it going to Corinne.

The 10% matches this channel. Bettina corrected her earlier 12% note to 10% on 2025-11-17. That is the only mention of the figure there, and I couldn't find a signed record of it.

Ruth, Anselm and June aren't members of #coastal-team, so they may not see my reply. You may need to ping them directly to get "today" met. Once both approvals are in, I'll save the draft. A person has to send it, because I can only save drafts.
